verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents the underlying close activities: automated bank reconciliation workflows, adjustment journal entries that could carry accruals, and accountant access to update journal entries and the chart of accounts. Nothing in the evidence shows a month-end close checklist, close-period tracking, or review sign-off workflow, so the accountant would track the close outside the product. Missing for 10: a close checklist or task tracker, tracking of reconciliation and accrual status, review/approval sign-offs, period locking or close status, and any independent corroboration.
